verdict: Yes, if you have a real process edge. Tagz Foods pitched popped potato chips, neither fried nor baked, on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal. Chips are India's biggest snack category, and buyers want a less oily version, but big brands can copy a 'healthy' claim quickly, so the product has to taste as good as the fried kind.
angle: Popped, baked and air-fried chips cut oil without giving up crunch. Quick commerce, offices and cinemas are good launch channels. Your flavours and taste, not just the health claim, decide whether buyers come back.
